votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Hughes to approve the conditional use permit to develop building 1100, a single-story building, on Lot 1 in the Commerce Point Phase 1 commercial subdivision for exceeding 20,000 sq. feet. Councilmember Hughes asked why this needs a conditional use permit. Community Development Director John Willis explained a conditional use permit is required due to the size of the building. The project exceeds 20,000 sq. ft. aggregate for all of the buildings triggering the need for a conditional use permit. Councilmember Hughes added “for exceeding 20,000 sq. feet” to his motion.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
